id./param/scenario/cs/a_110_cs_060.pack|cs_: "Did you find the ones who fled from the altar?
"No, not yet. What about the Darkspawn?
"No luck. He's nowhere to be seen. Damn, they're fast on their feet!
"There's a woman with him! What do we do?!
"General Hendrik only told us to capture the Darkspawn! Kill the woman! It doesn't matter! She's the Darkspawn's ally!
"T-this is bad. I have to call General Hendrik...
"Ugh! He's gone to call reinforcements. {var:1}! Hurry down the mountain and rejoin the others!
